originalIdentity: One bare-faced, dark-eyed rider with tan skin, long black braid and short face-framing hair, brown stitched fur-edged cap, small gold drop earring, cream/tan laced tunic, blue-gray near shoulder plate in idle, brown bracers and cross-body leather strap, dark trousers and tall brown boots. Seated on a stocky gray-brown wolf with cream cheek/chest fur, pointed ears, amber-brown eyes, large paws and a hanging bushy tail. Rope chest harness and rust-red-bordered saddle blanket remain distinct from wolf fur.
equipmentIdentity: Both hands hold the same short wooden-shaft spear with a steel leaf/triangular point aimed upper-right. Near bare hand is the rear grip at screen-left/lower shaft; far hand has a pale cloth wrap at the forward screen-right grip. A small plain round brown side shield is behind the forward forearm. No sword, bow, antlers or mount armor.
symbolReview: No faction emblem on the plain round brown shield. Keep the small pale gray angular border marks on the rust-edged saddle blanket as observed decorative marks, without inventing runic meaning. Gold drop earring and chest tie knot are costume details, not heraldry.
originalFrameReview: All four original cells retain the same wolf/rider/spear identity. Wolf gait differences are modest. Original third attack remains a near-idle spear hold rather than a clear thrust. The blue-gray near shoulder plate visible in idle and walk-a disappears into tan cloth in attack and walk-b; the remake should consistently retain the verified idle plate and record this continuity repair.

independentAssets.policy: Equipment icon and independent thrust impact FX remain separate. No speed trails, slash arcs or glow painted into the unit.

semanticReview: Mounted wolf plus spear is consistent with actual rules. Attack should be a clear two-hand spear thrust, with the wolf braced or lunging and the side shield retained. Opposite wolf diagonal steps should carry the seated rider, with one shared camera and scale.
footprintClarification: Original art contract is 32x48, anchor [16,47], footprint [1,1]. This describes the legacy art; it is not a reason to shrink the mount/rider to a 44-high standing human. No gameplay footprint or movement rule changes.

scaleProposal.rationale: A seated rider keeps head, hand and boot mass comparable with the approved 44-high human family. The mount increases the whole unit to a proposed 52-high silhouette, below the accepted 56-high juvenile dragon, with a broad 48-54-wide wolf rather than a vertically cramped legacy frame. Actual idle measurement and side-by-side native review lock one final scale for all poses; no independent per-pose fitting.

walk-a: one diagonal wolf paw pair supports while opposite pair steps; rider follows saddle without changing body size

walk-b: opposite diagonal wolf contacts from walk-a; same rider, wolf, spear, saddle and shield
